Name: Em's Cats
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
Fifteen options for each cat. Making them softer and more realistic-looking
Also changes the adoption icon at Marnie's
Available for Content Patcher and Alternative textures﻿

The different types are:
﻿Orange (orange striped)
Grey (grey striped)
Blonde (blonde)
White (white)
Black (black)
Purple (iridium)
Calico (black, orange and white)
ColorPoint (brown and white)
Tuxedo (black and white)
Tabby (brown striped)
Tortie (black and orange)
Long (white and grey)
Harlequin (white and orange)
Naked (pink)
NakedGrey (grey and pink)

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/5ySh95dL/AT.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's Cats AT"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Buy the paint tools from Robin at the Carpenter's shop
With the scissors selected, left-click the cat and choose its type
Enjoy!

Note: The adoption icon default is set to the five original colours. Any cat bought at Marnie's shop gets a type assigned at random and can be changed with the scissors. For those who want to avoid the chance of getting the vanilla game texture when adopting a cat, both the CP and AT versions can be installed side by side. This way, when you adopt a cat, it will always be an Em's version!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]﻿

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's Cats CP"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!

The default for each cat is its original colour. To choose a different type:
Open ﻿the [i]config.json[/i] file in the Cat mod folder
Replace the "﻿[color=#e69138]Color[/color]" with the name of the type you like
The choice you make also affects Marnie's adoption icon
Save and close the folder again, and you're all set!
